sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:33

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:33:1
items.html:
From those discernments that are in the seven lower Nekudot, from there the Partzufim of Arich Anpin and of AVI, etc., were made: That is, by means of the sortings, in partnership with the new MA, as written in its place. And even the Partzuf AA was made from the discernment of the NHY of Keter that was sorted and corrected with the help of the new MA, because of the annulment of the posterior that occurred there at the time of the breaking of the vessels, as is known. And know that these NHY of Keter, from which AA of Atzilut was made, are regarded as the discernment of the seven lower Sefirot of Keter. For this is the rule: everything that was in the Partzuf of Nekudim from the beginning of its emanation, that is, as it came out from the Nikvey Einayim, is considered GAR, for the reason that the light of the Einayim, from the beginning of their emanation, shone only to the GAR of the Nekudim, as above in the Inner Light, since nothing came out from the light of the Einayim but the discernment of a Rosh without a Guf, because phase one does not shine to the Guf, as above in the words of the ARI (Part 3, Chapter 1, item 6. See there). And therefore the ZAT of the Nekudim had only an illumination of vessels alone, from the discernment of the look of the Einayim into the AHP, as written below.
And with this you will understand that every discernment of Gadlut that reached them in the secret of an addition to what they had from the beginning of their emanation is regarded as the discernment of ZAT and vessels of the posterior, for they took them from the discernment of the nails of the feet of SAG, as above.
